visual_description: A handheld power tool with a thick, ergonomic handle and a circular, serrated steel blade. The blade does not rotate; it vibrates in a tight arc. It is shown mid-cut, slicing a clean line through the white plaster of the TRX-07 jacket. A small plume of white dust is being sucked into the nearby snorkel.

constraints.material: Medical-grade stainless steel; high-impact blue plastic housing; heavy-duty power cord.
constraints.logic: The 'First Move' in the lab. Used to remove the 'Cap' of the plaster jacket.
